worked_solution:
We multiply each row in the matrix by the column vector using the dot product:

$$
\begin{aligned}By & =[\begin{aligned}6p & -4q \\ -5p & 2q\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}p \\ q\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}6p\cdot p & + & (-4q)\cdot q \\ -5p\cdot p & + & \,\,\,\,\,\,\,2q\cdot q\end{aligned}\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}6{p}^{2}-4{q}^{2} \\ -5{p}^{2}+2{q}^{2}\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
